forms-commands-desc: Forms and the kill ritual: shift a walker between its two bodies, or run the self-test
forms-shift-desc: Shifts every loaded walker, or the one with this entity id, into its other body at once
forms-test-desc: Spawns walkers at the world spawn, runs the shift, the guise's death and the silver and fire kills on them, and removes them
forms-status: Forms: {0} walker bodies await the ritual
itemdesc-walkereyes: Two knots of dark wood, like old pine, the red in them gone dull. Still warm. Not watching anymore.
itemdesc-walkerfur: Finest coat I ever took off anything, and off nothing I could name. It is still warm.
game:ingamediscovery-walkers-banish: The trees are only trees again.
itemdesc-casthead-spear-silver: Add a stick to make a silver spear.
itemdesc-casthead-arrow-silver: Add a stick and a feather to make a silver arrow.
itemdesc-casthead-knife-silver: Add a stick to make a silver knife.
itemdesc-spear-silver: A spear with a soft cast silver head: weaker and shorter-lived than copper. Can be thrown.
blockdesc-silvermold-raw-spear: Fire it in a pit kiln or beehive kiln to use it.
blockdesc-silvermold-raw-arrow: Fire it in a pit kiln or beehive kiln to use it.
blockdesc-silvermold-raw-knife: Fire it in a pit kiln or beehive kiln to use it.
blockdesc-silvermold-fired-arrow: Pour 100 units of molten silver to cast four arrowheads.
blockdesc-silvermold-fired-spear: Pour 100 units of molten silver to cast a head. Takes silver only.
blockdesc-silvermold-fired-knife: Pour 100 units of molten silver to cast a head. Takes silver only.
blockcraftdesc-silvermold-raw-arrow: To cast silver arrowheads, four at a time
